detail: 62/62 acceptance (38 line placement + 24 ring placement, separate invocations: module fixtures cannot coexist)
golden: fabric_configs 24/24, ring_mock 72/72, regression 6/6, test_golden all supported cells pass, unsupported xfail

INC_GROUP=4 hang: leader re-arms (decrements) its arrival counter at kernel end before group members polled it; members spin forever. Fix: members ack observations to the leader (program semaphore 3); leader re-arms after all acks.
INC_GROUP=4: ring G=4 PCC 0.84-0.93. Fused inc flush orders only its own write; other group members data can be in flight. Lever removed (incorrect).
final: acceptance 62/62 (plain + --dev), golden supported cells all pass, fabric_configs 24/24, ring_mock 72/72. Focus 132-134us chips1-3 (161 chip0 skew); GLM 206; MiMo 242-248

what: Perf lamp suggests folding the arrival increment into every port_group-th core share with cores waiting on a group counter. Implemented, it is incorrect: a fused write+inc flush only orders its own write, so other cores data in the group may still be in flight (4-chip ring PCC 0.84-0.93). blackhole-ccl-kernels.md inc_every pattern implies one inc covers earlier chunks, which is not safe across different destination cores.
suggest: State in blackhole-ccl-kernels.md that a fused inc only guarantees chunks to the same destination core; drop or rework the lamp.

what: line_mesh and ring_mesh are separate module-scoped fixtures; when the whole file runs, ring_mesh opens while line_mesh is still open -> 24 test_ring errors (!devices_still_open). Docstring claims a parametrized fixture groups tests by placement, but it is not.
suggest: Make the placement a single parametrized module fixture (or close line_mesh before ring tests) so one invocation can pass.

what: No documented Python way to get the allocatable L1 region; get_max_worker_l1_unreserved_size looks right but is ~70 KiB larger than l1_bank_size (allocator base 111616 on BH), causing CB/L1-buffer clashes. ttnn._ttnn.reports.get_device_info(mesh).l1_bank_size is the right number.
suggest: Document l1_bank_size (already past the allocator base) as the L1 budget source.

what: Rule 6 says to find Ethernet cores with a probe kernel, but one-dispatch ops cannot probe. The probe-free path works: the first runtime arg of setup_fabric_connection is the eth channel, which indexes the chip non-harvested eth list (_chip_maps(...)[0]); not arch eth[chan].
suggest: Add the probe-free channel->core mapping to blackhole-fabric.md rule 6.

what: After a passing --dev fabric run the next mesh open fails (eth core heartbeat), but run_safe_pytest.sh only resets after hangs and agents may not run tt-smi -r. The only workaround was touching /tmp/tt-device.dirty so the wrapper resets under its lock.
suggest: Document the dirty-flag path or have the wrapper reset after --dev fabric runs.

detail: R2 WIP: mirrored half orders + FPU finish adds + streamed fin write + disjoint senders + lookahead-after-barrier. Focus traced 127.6-128.2us (baseline traced 137.5-141). acceptance 38+24 pass, precision rel_rms 0.00454
